geopolitics_summary: COP31 climate negotiations weakening on fossil-fuel language; EU methane rules delayed 2 years under US/industry pressure; sanctions posture hardening.

themes.headline: EU methane rules delayed two years following US pressure campaign
themes.why_it_matters: Delay postpones upstream methane abatement costs, reducing upward pressure on gas prices. Extends timeline for EU gas decarbonization targets; TTF structural support weakens as compliance deadlines recede.

themes.headline: COP31 draft text signals weakening commitment to immediate fossil-fuel phase-out
themes.why_it_matters: Softened language on fossil-fuel transition increases likelihood of prolonged coal/gas usage globally. Reduces regulatory tail-risk on EU EUA prices and delays urgency of fuel-switching in power generation.

themes.headline: US natural gas storage ends injection season 2% above five-year average
themes.why_it_matters: Above-normal US inventories (3,810 Bcf) reduce winter export arbitrage incentive. Lower US-to-EU LNG economics weaken TTF support; indirect bearish transmission via global LNG spot competition.

themes.headline: Middle East chokepoint oil flows surged 19% in Q3 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Increased Strait of Hormuz throughput reduces supply-shock tail-risk on crude and indirect knock-on to European energy margin. Materially lower geopolitical premium supports thermal coal/gas substitution margin.

themes.headline: EU appoints Swedish diplomat as sanctions envoy amid Russia posture hardening
themes.why_it_matters: Sanctions escalation escalates risk of Russian gas/coal supply disruption or pricing volatility. Structural risk to European power stability; EUA and power forwards likely to reprice higher if sanctions tighten winter supply.

watchlist: COP31 final text conclusion (Antalya); outcome on fossil-fuel language carries EUA / power curve implications.
UK-EU summit outcome: energy cooperation / trade reset; potential impact on GB-EU power interconnects and arbitrage.
EU methane rule implementation review in 2028; market will begin pricing delayed compliance risk post-2026.
Sanctions envoy mandate clarity: monitor for Russia energy isolation escalation over next 2–4 weeks.
